title: Writing the eulogy for one of the 'Invisibles'

tellings.quote: during the time that I knew Tyler uh there were other people like him Invisibles like I called them the Invisibles right and one of them had passed away and this is a person whose family didn't even know what they did

plain: Some time in the 2010s, one of the people who did hidden government work died, a person whose own family never knew what they did, and Diana Pasulka, a researcher who studies religion and UFO belief, says she wrote the eulogy. Pasulka tells it first-hand: while she knew a man she calls Tyler, she met others like him she named "the Invisibles", people whose real jobs stayed secret even from those closest to them. She tells it to show how fully such work can disappear from view.
